messages:
Noah (CS): quick sync from onboarding with Nimbus Labs — they like throughput but surfaced 3 items that could drive renewal conversations. pasting notes.
Ivy (CSM): short summary: finance needs per-campaign invoicing, ops hit duplicate downstream events after retries, product wants clearer per-route latency slices. risk = medium.
Noah (CS): customer asks: 
- pass-through campaign tagging for invoice reconciliation (header or metadata)
- optional server-side retry with idempotency token + DLQ option
- per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95) in console or CSV export
Noah (CS): they included an example header they currently send: `X-Invoice-Campaign: nimbus-q1` and a curl example they used when duplicates occurred.
Ivy (CSM): they run ~5 routes: score, enrich, summarize, embed, annotate. score route duplicates caused billing noise.
Sam (PM): which of these is the fastest to ship to reduce renewal risk?
Rowan (Eng): quickest = header passthrough + include campaign field in usage export CSV. low effort (~1 sprint) for logging and export mapping. adding per-route percentiles uses existing metrics pipeline (~1 sprint). server-side retry + idempotency + DLQ is heavier (routing + DLQ design) ~2-3 sprints.
Ivy (CSM): customer priority order: cost attribution (finance), retry safety (ops), then fine-grained metrics (product). if we ship campaign export quickly it buys breathing room.
Noah (CS): action: I'll open a ticket with acceptance criteria and attach their sample CSV rows + curl. will confirm header name with them.
SupportBot: created ticket RW-7133 "invoice-campaign tagging MVP for exports" assigned to Product; https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-7133 :white_check_mark:
Sam (PM): Rowan, can you add a short tech note on idempotency header format and DLQ semantics in RW-7133 by Thurs so we can scope retries work?
Rowan (Eng): will add tech note + effort estimate.
Ivy (CSM): I'll tell the customer we can prioritize campaign exports this sprint and follow up on retries timeline.
Noah (CS): closing loop here  will post updates after ticket grooming and sprint planning. thanks team.
